content.content: {"result":"{\"documentId\": \"f_6feda53b2382c63bf47b25\", \"title\": \"Angel note: how to count the money\", \"name\": \"Angel note: how to count the money\", \"revisionId\": \"a7f6f837df\", \"createdTime\": \"2026-02-12T23:52:18Z\", \"modifiedTime\": \"2026-02-13T00:41:06Z\", \"text\": \"Angel note: how to count the money\\nAngels will ask what each bet cost and what it brought in. This is how we count it so the three of us say the same thing. It replaces the quick plan I left on our board.\\nGo by the bank. SVB\\u2019s Payment Processed notices are the one place I know with a line per payment, and what the banks say is our ground source of truth. Start at the first SVB wires in Sep 2023 and stop at the last run on Feb 2. Anything paid out of Chase isn\\u2019t in here.\\nWhat counts is money that left the company and stayed out. A notice is where you start, not the last word. Take a notice as paid unless one of us has said the money came back. If someone we paid closes out their file with us and tells us what they received, that beats the notices for them. Money we moved between our own accounts isn\\u2019t spending, no bucket for that. Every payee keeps its line, even at zero.\\nIf we paid a contractor some other way, it goes in only if a receipt for it reached your mail, at the amount sent, not the fee.\\nBuckets. Build is the team on Deel plus the studios and freelancers who made the games. Everything on Deel counts as team, don\\u2019t try to split it. Marketing is anything made or bought to get installs (ad networks, agencies, ad creative, playables, trailers): list it under its bet by date like the rest, but keep it out of build cost, I have those numbers. Company is legal, tools, the website, equipment and anything else that wasn\\u2019t for one of the three games: that goes in the Company column. Our own pay and anyone on Gusto aren\\u2019t in here.\\nWhich bet. Go by the Transaction Date on the notice, the whole payment to one bet: Domino Delights up to Jan 8, 2025, ZM from Jan 9, 2025 to Nov 23, 2025, Combo Fighter from Nov 24, 2025. Don\\u2019t try to work out who was on what, that\\u2019s where we\\u2019d start arguing.\\nAnything not paid in dollars stays in its own currency next to the line. Don\\u2019t add it to a dollar total.\\nWhat each game brought in is its lifetime revenue from the warehouse\\u2019s daily revenue table, as recorded. Leave Combo Fighter\\u2019s revenue off for now, on the page, on the deck and when you tell me, until we\\u2019ve checked its first sales.\\nOn the Linear project: move each payee\\u2019s issue to Done once its line is right. If your figure isn\\u2019t what the notices add up to, say why on the issue first.\\n\"}"}

Go by the bank. SVB’s Payment Processed notices are the one place I know with a line per payment, and what the banks say is our ground source of truth. Start at the first SVB wires in Sep 2023 and stop at the last run on Feb 2. Anything paid out of Chase isn’t in here.
What counts is money that left the company and stayed out. A notice is where you start, not the last word. Take a notice as paid unless one of us has said the money came back. If someone we paid closes out their file with us and tells us what they received, that beats the notices for them. Money we moved between our own accounts isn’t spending, no bucket for that. Every payee keeps its line, even at zero.
If we paid a contractor some other way, it goes in only if a receipt for it reached your mail, at the amount sent, not the fee.
Buckets. Build is the team on Deel plus the studios and freelancers who made the games. Everything on Deel counts as team, don’t try to split it. Marketing is anything made or bought to get installs (ad networks, agencies, ad creative, playables, trailers): list it under its bet by date like the rest, but keep it out of build cost, I have those numbers. Company is legal, tools, the website, equipment and anything else that wasn’t for one of the three games: that goes in the Company column. Our own pay and anyone on Gusto aren’t in here.
Which bet. Go by the Transaction Date on the notice, the whole payment to one bet: Domino Delights up to Jan 8, 2025, ZM from Jan 9, 2025 to Nov 23, 2025, Combo Fighter from Nov 24, 2025. Don’t try to work out who was on what, that’s where we’d start arguing.
Anything not paid in dollars stays in its own currency next to the line. Don’t add it to a dollar total.
What each game brought in is its lifetime revenue from the warehouse’s daily revenue table, as recorded. Leave Combo Fighter’s revenue off for now, on the page, on the deck and when you tell me, until we’ve checked its first sales.
On the Linear project: move each payee’s issue to Done once its line is right. If your figure isn’t what the notices add up to, say why on the issue first.
"}

import json,re
d=json.load(open('/tmp/mails.json'))
ids=open('/tmp/notice_ids.txt').read().split()
rows=[]
for i in ids:
    k=[x for x in d if i in x]
    if not k: continue
    b=d[k[0]]['body']
    m=re.search(r'To: (.*?) \*\*\*(\d{4})\s*Amount: ([\d,\.]+) ([A-Z]{3})\s*Transaction Date: (\w{3} \d{2} \d{4})',b)
    if not m: print('NOPARSE',i,b[:400]); continue
    rows.append(dict(id=i,payee=m.group(1),acct=m.group(2),amt=float(m.group(3).replace(',','')),cur=m.group(4),date=m.group(5),frm=re.search(r'From: (.*?) \*\*\*',b).group(1)))
rows.append(dict(id='1393165655.1696276867449',payee='Leapblock LTD',acct='1359',amt=22260.0,cur='USD',date='Oct 02 2023',frm='x'))

json.dump(rows,open('/tmp/rows.json','w'),indent=0)
print(len(rows))
from collections import defaultdict
agg=defaultdict(lambda:[0,0.0,set()])
for r in rows:
    a=agg[(r['payee'],r['acct'],r['cur'])]; a[0]+=1;a[1]+=r['amt'];a[2].add(r['frm'])

    for d,a,cur,s in items[k]:
        if k in zero: continue
        if cur!='USD': other.append(f'{a:,.2f} {cur} ({d})'); continue
        col='Company' if bucket=='Company' else bet(d)
        c[col]+=a
    line=round(sum(c.values()),2)
    out.append(dict(key=k,label=label,banks=' / '.join(banks),bucket=bucket,issue=iss,**{x:round(y,2) for x,y in c.items()},line=line,notices=notice_tot.get(k,0),other=other,n=len(items[k])))
    for x in c: tot[(bucket,x)]+=c[x]
for o in out: print(o['issue'],o['label'][:34].ljust(34),o['bucket'][:9].ljust(9),f"{o['DD']:>12,.2f} {o['ZM']:>12,.2f} {o['CF']:>11,.2f} {o['Company']:>10,.2f} | line {o['line']:>12,.2f} notices {o['notices']:>12,.2f}",o['other'])

print('quick pass by date', {b:round(sum(r['amt'] for r in rows if r['cur']=='USD' and bet(r['dt'])==b),2) for b in ['DD','ZM','CF']})
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/out.json','w'),indent=1)

Marcus’s company, direct monthly wire since Oct 2023. 28 notices.
Paid by the day. SVB shows their bank’s name (accounts ***3341, ***8605). 11 notices.
3 SVB wires ($6,450, Sep–Nov 2024) + 5 Western Union receipts in my mail, Jun–Aug 2024 ($7,525 sent; $0.99 fees left out).
Art direction and a look at our AI art pipeline. Paid end of May 2025.
Short animation job, coins and chests. Aug 2024.
2D animation, a week or two. Mar 2025.

Second half of the UX job on the dominoes game, paid after the raise. Nov 2023.
Incent UA on iOS in the US. Marketing: listed under its bet, not in build cost. 3 notices.
Node Media, UA agency (late 2024 fees and creative concepts), one catch-up payment Jan 2 2025, so Domino Delights by date. Marketing, not in build cost.
Past-due UA bills (Aug 29 and Nov 12, 2025). Marketing, not in build cost.
First playable ad. SVB shows them as CREATIVE X TEKNOLOJi. Marketing, not in build cost.
$500/month contract to run paid UA on Telegram. Marketing, not in build cost. Oct 30 is ZM; Dec 1 and Jan 6 are Combo Fighter.

Harmony Games logo/brand trademark filings, Nov 2023 – Mar 2025. 4 notices.
$500 for help on the 4X proposal, not one of the three games. May 2025.
Laptop paid direct to Martin, Oct 30 2025, in leva. Stays in BGN, not in any dollar total.
Aug 19 2024, $4,000 to our own Chase account (Blake, Feb 13): money moved between our own accounts, not spending. Kept at $0.
Team on Deel + studios and freelancers who made the games.
Ad networks, agencies, playables, ad video. Kept out of build cost.
Company (not one of the three games)
Legal, tools, website, trademarks, the 4X proposal. Plus 1,999.00 BGN for the laptop, not added in.
ANALYTICS.MONETIZATION.REVENUE_DAILY as recorded (IAP + ad). Combo Fighter left off until its first sales are checked.
Quick pass on the draft deck (all USD notices by date)
What changes: build only (marketing, Company, the own-account transfer and the returned wire out), plus Leapblock’s close-out and Lucas’s Western Union receipts.

content.text:
I've built Leonard's one-page sheet in your Drive, shared it with him and Blake (both can edit), closed out the Payee history project in Linear, and replied to him in #winddown. I posted the reply in his thread and also sent it to the channel. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1vuPkzmQa0Sjfz4PMRkOj-yt1icb_6LZhe2dcH05tiZM/edit

**What each bet cost to build and brought in**

| | Cost to build | Brought in |
|---|---|---|
| Domino Delights | $963,374.64 | $12,331.25 |
| ZM | $544,433.44 | $11.99 |
| Combo Fighter | $72,685.61 | left off, as he asked |

Build cost is the team on Deel plus the studios and freelancers. Revenue is each game's lifetime total from the warehouse's daily revenue table. The sheet uses the column layout of his working sheet, and every payee keeps its line, even at zero.

**What changes on his draft deck**
- **Cost slide:** Domino Delights goes from $985K to $963K, ZM from $609K to $544K, and Combo Fighter from $74K to $73K.
- **"What each brought in" slide:** Domino Delights $12.3K, ZM $12, Combo Fighter stays off.

His quick numbers were simply all the SVB payment notices added up by date. I matched them to the cent, so no notices are missing. The numbers move for these reasons:
- **Marketing is kept out of build cost:** $16.4K for Domino Delights, $56.5K for ZM and $1K for Combo Fighter (ad networks, the UA agency, the playable ad, the Telegram UA contractor). It's still listed under each bet.
- **Company costs go in their own column:** $49,625 for legal, the attribution tool, trademarks, the website and the 4X proposal.
- **Two payments count as $0:**
  - The $4,000 to JPMorgan was our own Chase account, per Blake's email on Feb 13.
  - Oleg's $125 wire came back. Leonard re-sent it through Payoneer, but your mail only has Payoneer payment requests, not a receipt, so under his rules it stays out.
- **Two additions:**
  - Leapblock's accountant closed their file on Feb 13 and said they received 30 wires totaling $407,944. Your mail has notices for 29 of them ($374,654). The missing one is the first wire, $33,290 on Sep 13, 2023. Their figure matches year by year, so I used it.
  - Lucas was also paid $7,525 through Western Union from June to August 2024, and the receipts are in your mail. That's the amount sent, without fees.
- **Martin's laptop** was paid in Bulgarian leva (1,999 BGN). Per his rules it stays in leva and isn't added to any dollar total.

All 22 payee issues in Linear are now Done. Leapblock, Lucas, Oleg and JPMorgan differ from what their notices add up to, so each of those got a comment explaining why before I closed it.

Two classification calls Leonard may want to check:
- I counted Graham Porter's $5,000 for a month of art direction as build cost for ZM.
- I counted the $16,428.57 to Node Media, a UA agency, as marketing for Domino Delights. It was one catch-up payment for late-2024 invoices, paid on Jan 2, 2025, which falls in the Domino Delights period.
